articles.title: Ciena Tumbles 10% as In-Line Guidance Overshadows Earnings Beat, Arista Edges Higher
articles.summary: Ciena just posted a record quarter with earnings well above estimates, yet its stock cratered 10% while networking peers Arista and Cisco held firm or climbed. The divergence points to a specific pressure point that separates Ciena's story from the broader AI networking boom.

articles.title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Joins A Major Enterprise AI Infrastructure Build
articles.summary: Super Micro Computer (NasdaqGS:SMCI) announced a new partnership with Cisco to supply high density liquid and air cooled compute systems for AI infrastructure. The company’s systems will be integrated into Cisco’s Secure AI Factory architecture, which uses NVIDIA technologies for enterprise, neocloud and sovereign cloud customers. articles.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Dropped, So What Is Driving Attention Now?
articles.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock is back in focus after the company and partners Cisco and HUMAIN outlined plans to deploy up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure in Saudi Arabia starting in 2027. Despite the Saudi AI announcement and other partnerships around secure AI infrastructure, Advanced Micro Devices’ recent share price has eased, with the 7-day share price return down 4.08% and the 90-day share price return down 15.28%.
